entities.summary: Denys Hennadiyovych Prokopenko is a Ukrainian military officer who is a Brigadier general in the National Guard of Ukraine and commander of the 1st Corps of the Ukrainian National Guard "Azov", as well as a prominent participant of the Russo-Ukrainian War, and former commander of the 12th Special Forces Brigade "Azov".
